segments.text: For example, how you approach a gist question, focusing on the main idea or purpose is different from a detail question where you need to catch specific facts.
segments.ipa: /fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl haʊ ju əˈproʊtʃ ə dʒɪst ˈkwɛstʃən ˈfoʊkəsɪŋ ɑn ðə meɪn aɪˈdiə ɔr ˈpɝpəs ɪz ˈdɪfərənt frʌm ə dɪˈteɪl ˈkwɛstʃən wɛr ju nid tu kætʃ spəˈsɪfɪk fækts/

segments.text: Give me an example like what am I listening for differently?
segments.ipa: /ɡɪv mi æn ɪɡˈzæmpəl laɪk wʌt æm aɪ ˈlɪsənɪŋ fɔr ˈdɪfrəntli/

segments.text: Okay, so for gist, you're listening for the big picture, the overall topic, the main point the speaker is making.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ soʊ fɔr dʒɪst jʊr ˈlɪsənɪŋ fɔr ðə bɪɡ ˈpɪktʃər ðə ˈoʊvərˌɔl ˈtɑpɪk ðə meɪn pɔɪnt ðə ˈspikər ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ/

segments.text: You might listen for introductory or concluding statements.
segments.ipa: /ju maɪt ˈlɪsən fɔr ˌɪntrəˈdʌktəri ɔr kənˈkludɪŋ ˈsteɪtmənts/

segments.text: For detail, your ears are tuned for specific names, dates, numbers, reasons, examples that are explicitly stated.
segments.ipa: /fɔr dɪˈteɪl jɔr ɪrz ɑr tund fɔr spəˈsɪfɪk neɪmz deɪts ˈnʌmbərz ˈrizənz ɪɡˈzæmpəlz ðæt ɑr ɪkˈsplɪsətli ˈsteɪtɪd/

segments.text: It's more about capturing those nuggets of information. Got it.
segments.ipa: /ɪts mɔr əˈbaʊt ˈkæptʃərɪŋ ðoʊz ˈnʌɡəts ʌv ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ɡɑt ɪt/

segments.text: The plan also really highlights recognizing signal words.
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ˈɔlsoʊ ˈrɪli ˈhaɪˌlaɪts ˈrɛkəɡˌnaɪzɪŋ ˈsɪɡnəl wɝdz/

segments.text: Signal words like transition words. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ˈsɪɡnəl wɝdz laɪk trænˈzɪʃən wɝdz ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: Words like however, therefore, in addition, for example, these words are like signposts in the lecture or conversation.
segments.ipa: /wɝdz laɪk ˌhaʊˈɛvər ˈðɛrˌfɔr ɪn əˈdɪʃən fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl ðiz wɝdz ɑr laɪk ˈsaɪnˌpoʊsts ɪn ðə ˈlɛktʃər ɔr ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən/

segments.text: They tell you about relationships between ideas, contrast, cause, effect, examples, sequence.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ tɛl ju əˈbaʊt riˈleɪʃənˌʃɪps bɪˈtwin aɪˈdiəz ˈkɑntræst kɑz ɪˈfɛkt ɪɡˈzæmpəlz ˈsikwəns/

segments.text: So, learning those helps you anticipate and follow the structure.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ˈlɝnɪŋ ðoʊz hɛlps ju ænˈtɪsəˌpeɪt ənd ˈfɑloʊ ðə ˈstrʌktʃər/

segments.text: Definitely, it helps you map the information as you listen.
segments.ipa: /ˈdɛfənətli ɪt hɛlps ju mæp ðə ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən æz ju ˈlɪsən/

segments.text: The plan also covers things like elimination techniques for the multiple choice answers, how to quickly roll out wrong options, timesaving strategies. Yes.
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ˈɔlsoʊ ˈkʌvərz θɪŋz laɪk ɪˌlɪməˈneɪʃən tɛkˈniks fɔr ðə ˈmʌltəpəl tʃɔɪs ˈænsərz haʊ tu ˈkwɪkli roʊl aʊt rɔŋ ˈɑpʃənz timesaving ˈstrætədʒiz jɛs/

segments.text: And there are specific exercises in the plan for this, too.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛr ɑr spəˈsɪfɪk ˈɛksərˌsaɪzəz ɪn ðə plæn fɔr ðɪs tu/

segments.text: Like a mini quiz just focused on identifying question types quickly from how they're worded. Ah, okay.
segments.ipa: /laɪk ə ˈmɪni kwɪz dʒʌst ˈfoʊkəst ɑn aɪˈdɛntəˌfaɪɪŋ ˈkwɛstʃən taɪps ˈkwɪkli frʌm haʊ ðɛr ˈwɝdɪd ɑ ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Practice recognizing what they're even asking, right?
segments.ipa: /ˈpræktəs ˈrɛkəɡˌnaɪzɪŋ wʌt ðɛr ˈivɪn ˈæskɪŋ raɪt/

segments.text: And then practice with short lectures followed by specific question types so you can apply those targeted strategies you've been learning.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛn ˈpræktəs wɪð ʃɔrt ˈlɛktʃərz ˈfɑloʊd baɪ spəˈsɪfɪk ˈkwɛstʃən taɪps soʊ ju kæn əˈplaɪ ðoʊz ˈtɑrɡətɪd ˈstrætədʒiz juv bɪn ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: Okay, that makes sense.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ðæt meɪks sɛns/

segments.text: Build the foundations, then practice applying specific strategies.
segments.ipa: /bɪld ðə faʊnˈdeɪʃənz ðɛn ˈpræktəs əˈplaɪɪŋ spəˈsɪfɪk ˈstrætədʒiz/

segments.text: But how do you pull all this together consistently?
segments.ipa: /bʌt haʊ du ju pʊl ɔl ðɪs təˈɡɛðər kənˈsɪstəntli/

segments.text: What about a daily routine? Good question.
segments.ipa: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ə ˈdeɪli ruˈtin ɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃən/

segments.text: The plan provides guidance on that, too.
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn prəˈvaɪdz ˈɡaɪdəns ɑn ðæt tu/

segments.text: It suggests a reasonable daily time commitment and talks about combining passive and active listening.
segments.ipa: /ɪt səˈdʒɛsts ə ˈrizənəbəl ˈdeɪli taɪm kəˈmɪtmənt ənd tɔks əˈbaʊt kəmˈbaɪnɪŋ ˈpæsɪv ənd ˈæktɪv ˈlɪsənɪŋ/

segments.text: Passive versus active listening.
segments.ipa: /ˈpæsɪv ˈvɝsəs ˈæktɪv ˈlɪsənɪŋ/

segments.text: What's the difference in practice?
segments.ipa: /wʌts ðə ˈdɪfərəns ɪn ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: Well, passive listening might just be having English news or podcasts on in the background while you do chores,
segments.ipa: /wɛl ˈpæsɪv ˈlɪsənɪŋ maɪt dʒʌst bi ˈhævɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ nuz ɔr podcasts ɑn ɪn ðə ˈbækˌɡraʊnd waɪl ju du tʃɔrz/

segments.text: getting your ear used to the sounds and rhythms.
segments.ipa: /ˈɡɛtɪŋ jɔr ir juzd tu ðə saʊndz ənd ˈrɪðəmz/

segments.text: It's absorbing it kind of.
segments.ipa: /ɪts əbˈzɔrbɪŋ ɪt kaɪnd ʌv/

segments.text: But active listening is focused effort.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ˈæktɪv ˈlɪsənɪŋ ɪz ˈfoʊkəst ˈɛfərt/

segments.text: You're really paying attention, maybe taking notes, trying to understand the main points, the details.
segments.ipa: /jʊr ˈrɪli ˈpeɪɪŋ əˈtɛnʃən ˈmeɪbi ˈteɪkɪŋ noʊts ˈtraɪɪŋ tu ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə meɪn pɔɪnts ðə dɪˈteɪlz/

segments.text: That's where the skill building really happens, right?
segments.ipa: /ðæts wɛr ðə skɪl ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈrɪli ˈhæpənz raɪt/

segments.text: The plan also introduces the shadowing technique. Shadowing. What's that?
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ˈɔlsoʊ ˌɪntrəˈdusɪz ðə ˈʃædoʊɪŋ tɛkˈnik ˈʃædoʊɪŋ wʌts ðæt/

segments.text: It's where you listen to audio and try to repeat what the speaker is saying almost simultaneously mimicking their pronunciation and intonation. Wow.
segments.ipa: /ɪts wɛr ju ˈlɪsən tu ˈɑdiˌoʊ ənd traɪ tu rɪˈpit wʌt ðə ˈspikər ɪz ˈseɪɪŋ ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˌsaɪməlˈteɪniəsli ˈmɪmɪkɪŋ ðɛr proʊˌnʌnsiˈeɪʃən ənd ˌɪntəˈneɪʃən waʊ/

segments.text: Okay, that sounds challenging.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ðæt saʊndz ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ/

segments.text: It can be at first, but it's incredibly powerful for improving your comprehension speed,
segments.ipa: /ɪt kæn bi æt fɝst bʌt ɪts ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbli ˈpaʊərfəl fɔr ˌɪmˈpruvɪŋ jɔr ˌkɑmpriˈhɛnʃən spid/

segments.text: your pronunciation, and just your overall processing of spoken English. Interesting technique.
segments.ipa: /jɔr proʊˌnʌnsiˈeɪʃən ənd dʒʌst jɔr ˈoʊvərˌɔl ˈprɑsɛsɪŋ ʌv ˈspoʊkən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈɪntrəstɪŋ tɛkˈnik/

segments.text: And does the plan suggest specific resources for this daily practice?
segments.ipa: /ənd dʌz ðə plæn səˈdʒɛst spəˈsɪfɪk ˈrisɔrsɪz fɔr ðɪs ˈdeɪli ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: Oh yeah, lots of good accessible stuff.
segments.ipa: /oʊ jæ lɑts ʌv ɡʊd ækˈsɛsəbəl stʌf/

segments.text: NPR, TED talks, BBC news, educational YouTube channels, things that offer authentic, often academic style spoken English. Okay.
segments.ipa: /ˈɛnˈpiˈɑr tɛd tɔks ˌbibiˈsi nuz ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃənəl ˈjutˌjub ˈtʃænəlz θɪŋz ðæt ˈɔfər əˈθɛntɪk ˈɔfən ˌækəˈdɛmɪk staɪl ˈspoʊkən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Readily available content. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ˈrɛdəli əˈveɪləbəl ˈkɑntɛnt ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: And it even gives a sample daily schedule structure like block out time for vocab review,
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪt ˈivɪn ɡɪvz ə ˈsæmpəl ˈdeɪli ˈskɛdʒʊl ˈstrʌktʃər laɪk blɑk aʊt taɪm fɔr vocab ˌrivˈju/

segments.text: then some focused listening and note-taking, then practice questions, and always ending with some review or reflection on what you learned or struggled with.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn sʌm ˈfoʊkəst ˈlɪsənɪŋ ənd note-taking ðɛn ˈpræktəs ˈkwɛstʃənz ənd ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈɛndɪŋ wɪð sʌm ˌrivˈju ɔr rɪˈflɛkʃən ɑn wʌt ju lɝnd ɔr ˈstrʌɡəld wɪð/

segments.text: Structured daily chunks, right?
segments.ipa: /ˈstrʌktʃərd ˈdeɪli tʃʌŋks raɪt/

segments.text: Plus, there's a bonus resource list in the plan.
segments.ipa: /plʌs ðɛrz ə ˈboʊnəs ˈrisɔrs lɪst ɪn ðə plæn/

segments.text: Over 20 podcasts and video channels, some with comprehension questions included.
segments.ipa: /ˈoʊvər podcasts ənd ˈvɪdioʊ ˈtʃænəlz sʌm wɪð ˌkɑmpriˈhɛnʃən ˈkwɛstʃənz ˌɪnˈkludəd/

segments.text: So, it's about making listening practice a consistent habit, weaving it into your day.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈpræktəs ə kənˈsɪstənt ˈhæbət ˈwivɪŋ ɪt ˈɪntu jɔr deɪ/

segments.text: Consistency is definitely the key and that consistent practice builds towards the next important phase simulating the real test.
segments.ipa: /kənˈsɪstənsi ɪz ˈdɛfənətli ðə ki ənd ðæt kənˈsɪstənt ˈpræktəs bɪldz təˈwɔrdz ðə nɛkst ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt feɪz ˈsɪmjəˌleɪtɪŋ ðə ril tɛst/

segments.text: Ah the mock tests again but maybe more strategically this time. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ɑ ðə mɑk tɛsts əˈɡɛn bʌt ˈmeɪbi mɔr strəˈtidʒɪkli ðɪs taɪm ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: The plan stresses taking fulllength mock TOEFL listening tests under realistic conditions.
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ˈstrɛsəz ˈteɪkɪŋ fulllength mɑk TOEFL ˈlɪsənɪŋ tɛsts ˈʌndər ˌriəˈlɪstɪk kənˈdɪʃənz/

segments.text: Find a quiet space.
segments.ipa: /faɪnd ə ˈkwaɪət speɪs/

segments.text: Time yourself strictly.
segments.ipa: /taɪm jərˈsɛlf ˈstrɪktli/

segments.text: Mimic test day as much as possible.
segments.ipa: /ˈmɪmɪk tɛst deɪ æz mʌtʃ æz ˈpɑsəbəl/

segments.text: Getting used to the pressure. Yes.
segments.ipa: /ˈɡɛtɪŋ juzd tu ðə ˈprɛʃər jɛs/

segments.text: But crucially, it's not just about taking the test.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ˈkruʃəli ɪts nɑt dʒʌst əˈbaʊt ˈteɪkɪŋ ðə tɛst/

segments.text: It's about analyzing your performance afterwards.
segments.ipa: /ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈænəˌlaɪzɪŋ jɔr pərˈfɔrməns ˈæftərwərdz/

segments.text: The plan recommends using error logs and score trackers. Error logs.
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ˌrɛkəˈmɛndz ˈjuzɪŋ ˈɛrər lɔɡz ənd skɔr ˈtrækərz ˈɛrər lɔɡz/

segments.text: So, writing down every mistake. Yeah.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ˈraɪtɪŋ daʊn ˈɛvəri mɪˈsteɪk jæ/

segments.text: And more importantly, why you made the mistake.
segments.ipa: /ənd mɔr ˌɪmˈpɔrtəntli waɪ ju meɪd ðə mɪˈsteɪk/

segments.text: Was it vocab?
segments.ipa: /wɑz ɪt vocab/

segments.text: Did you misunderstand the question type?
segments.ipa: /dɪd ju ˌmɪsəndərˈstænd ðə ˈkwɛstʃən taɪp/

segments.text: Did you miss a key detail in your notes?
segments.ipa: /dɪd ju mɪs ə ki dɪˈteɪl ɪn jɔr noʊts/

segments.text: Identifying those patterns is gold.
segments.ipa: /aɪˈdɛntəˌfaɪɪŋ ðoʊz ˈpætərnz ɪz ɡoʊld/

segments.text: So, you can see if you keep making the same kind of error precisely.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ju kæn si ɪf ju kip ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðə seɪm kaɪnd ʌv ˈɛrər prɪˈsaɪsli/

segments.text: That analysis helps you see, okay, I consistently struggle with inference questions about the professor's attitude.
segments.ipa: /ðæt əˈnæləsəs hɛlps ju si ˌoʊˈkeɪ aɪ kənˈsɪstəntli ˈstrʌɡəl wɪð ˈɪnfərəns ˈkwɛstʃənz əˈbaʊt ðə prəˈfɛsərz ˈætəˌtud/

segments.text: Then you know exactly what strategy or skill to go back and reinforce, tailoring your review based on evidence from your own performance. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn ju noʊ ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ˈstrætədʒi ɔr skɪl tu ɡoʊ bæk ənd ˌriɪnˈfɔrs ˈteɪlərɪŋ jɔr ˌrivˈju beɪst ɑn ˈɛvədəns frʌm jɔr oʊn pərˈfɔrməns ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: And the study plan itself points you to a full practice test resource with answers and timing advice.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə ˈstʌdi plæn ˌɪtˈsɛlf pɔɪnts ju tu ə fʊl ˈpræktəs tɛst ˈrisɔrs wɪð ˈænsərz ənd ˈtaɪmɪŋ ædˈvaɪs/

segments.text: Very useful for this simulation phase. Okay.
segments.ipa: /ˈvɛri ˈjusfəl fɔr ðɪs ˌsɪmjəˈleɪʃən feɪz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Makes total sense.
segments.ipa: /meɪks ˈtoʊtəl sɛns/

segments.text: Practice, analyze, refine.
segments.ipa: /ˈpræktəs ˈænəˌlaɪz rəˈfaɪn/

segments.text: So after all that, what about the final stretch?
segments.ipa: /soʊ ˈæftər ɔl ðæt wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfaɪnəl strɛtʃ/

segments.text: The last week or so before the actual exam.
segments.ipa: /ðə læst wik ɔr soʊ bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈæktʃəwəl ɪɡˈzæm/

segments.text: The final week is about polishing and confidence building, not cramming new things.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈfaɪnəl wik ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈpɑlɪʃɪŋ ənd ˈkɑnfədəns ˈbɪldɪŋ nɑt ˈkræmɪŋ nu θɪŋz/

segments.text: The plan advises maybe a light review of your vocabulary log.
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ædˈvaɪzɪz ˈmeɪbi ə laɪt ˌrivˈju ʌv jɔr voʊˈkæbjəˌlɛri lɔɡ/

segments.text: Keep it fresh, right?
segments.ipa: /kip ɪt frɛʃ raɪt/

segments.text: And really focus your final practice sessions on those specific weak areas you identified from your mock test error logs.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈrɪli ˈfoʊkəs jɔr ˈfaɪnəl ˈpræktəs ˈsɛʃənz ɑn ðoʊz spəˈsɪfɪk wik ˈɛriəz ju aɪˈdɛntəˌfaɪd frʌm jɔr mɑk tɛst ˈɛrər lɔɡz/

segments.text: If not speed was an issue, do a few more timed note-taking drills. Targeted reinforcement. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /ɪf nɑt spid wɑz æn ˈɪʃu du ə fju mɔr taɪmd note-taking drɪlz ˈtɑrɡətɪd ˌriɪnˈfɔrsmənt ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: The plan also wisely includes reminders about managing stress, getting enough sleep, staying calm,
segments.ipa: /ðə plæn ˈɔlsoʊ ˈwaɪzli ˌɪnˈkludz riˈmaɪndərz əˈbaʊt ˈmænədʒɪŋ strɛs ˈɡɛtɪŋ ɪˈnʌf slip ˈsteɪɪŋ kɑm/

segments.text: and it even provides a practical day before checklist.
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪt ˈivɪn prəˈvaɪdz ə ˈpræktəkəl deɪ bɪˈfɔr ˈtʃɛˌklɪst/

segments.text: You know, logistics, what to bring, etc.
segments.ipa: /ju noʊ ləˈdʒɪstɪks wʌt tu brɪŋ ˌɛtˈsɛtərə/

segments.text: Little things that make a difference on the day for sure.
